verdict.rationale: Parahelp has Internal Agent automations that run on a schedule (e.g. weekday 9am) or a trigger (e.g. a GitHub PR merging). Those automations can watch connected tools and surface gaps, and knowledge changes are versioned with diffs. So an automation could plausibly keep knowledge current, but nothing documents a native connector that re-syncs knowledge sources. Configuration changes also need manual approval unless auto-approve is enabled. Missing for 10: an explicit scheduled or on-change knowledge-source sync feature, documentation of which sources sync automatically, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
